I designed the 20 experiments as 10 matched pairs. Within each pair the edit is the same, and the two parents differ only on the conditioning edge, so the difference between the pair's results isolates the interaction.

| Pair | Edit | Condition contrasted |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | edge 5 → none | edge 3 = skip vs none (whether the output stays reachable) |
| 2 | edge 3 → skip | rest of cell all-conv vs all-pool |
| 3 | edge 0 → conv3x3 | edges 2 and 4 active vs none (whether node 1 is a dead end) |
| 4 | edge 1 → conv3x3 | edge 5 = conv3x3 vs none |
| 5 | edge 4 → skip | edge 3 = skip vs none |
| 6 | edge 5 conv3x3 → conv1x1 | edge 2 = conv3x3 vs none |
| 7 | edge 0 conv3x3 → avg_pool | edge 4 = conv3x3 vs skip |
| 8 | edge 3 skip → conv3x3 | edge 5 = conv3x3 vs none |
| 9 | edge 2 none → conv3x3 | edge 0 = conv3x3 vs skip |
| 10 | edge 1 conv3x3 → skip | edge 3 = skip vs conv1x1 |
